item.description: AUD/USD trades around 0.7050 on Thursday at the time of writing, up 0.25% on the day, extending a positive momentum fueled by renewed optimism surrounding monetary policy in Australia.

item.title: GBP/JPY steadies near 212.00 as Yen recovery loses steam

item.title: CAD: BOC maintains cautious stance – BBH
item.description: According to Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH), the Bank of Canada has kept the policy rate unchanged at 2.25% for the second consecutive meeting, adopting a more cautious tone.

item.title: USD: Fed maintains rates, signals data-driven patience – TD Securities
item.description: TD Securities' Global Strategy Team reviews the recent FOMC meeting, where the Federal Reserve maintained rates at 3.50%-3.75%. The statement was marginally hawkish, with Chair Powell indicating that the Fed can be patient and let data guide future decisions.
